test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d38609a09fc038b46890d64d467b6d8e4b139603e497bd3fa8ea47c32a596c9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The number in the lower triangle is the half of the sum of the numbers of its two upper triangles.**

Let's check,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0905e75f817cbfa940632a6294fa582386d0a910dec2cfaf22354ff1f291b5fc.png] ⇒ 5 = (6 + 4) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8410198209e2a140669f1017ea52ce89e5cae3fb1668a76940098ab2bcb27aca.png] ⇒ 6 = (4 + 8) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10e0d40db76c06abee1efd8d9dd0d2fb6cac97bfe35860e800d2ef202fb2ce82.png] ⇒ 3 = (0 + 6) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b86fbbda9131c3249be78d0de0a209f6060fbca5402029ee4958ca8ba6d40954.png] ⇒ 5 = (6 + 4) ÷ 2

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57cd94e831fadb89ad24407deb1706729a1e613bfc06be96ae29cfd4efd382d4.png] ⇒ ? = (8 + 0) ÷ 2 = 4

Hence, the correct answer is **"4"**.
